summary.text: Brian Walker is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 31A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Harry Niska (R).
A former sheriff's deputy and Ramsey planning and parks commission member who says he was a Republican for most of his life, he is running on lowering costs for working families.

paragraphs.text: Brian Walker said in a Ballotpedia survey that he grew up on a farm in Kansas, served as a sheriff's deputy, and lives in Ramsey, Minnesota.
He wrote that he has served on the Ramsey Planning Commission and the Parks and Recreation Commission, and that he ran for Ramsey City Council in 2020 and lost.
Walker said he was a Republican most of his life and now identifies as a moderate Democrat.

He listed lowering the cost of living, family farms, clean water and oversight of data centers among his priorities, and said he supports a permanent state ban on sulfide mining in the Boundary Waters watershed.
